prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: whiplash. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1468; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Claimant reports neck pain and stiffness and has not yet sought medical treatment. Photos of both vehicles received from insured. Liability appears clear pending police report.

Entry 2: Contacted claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed no attorney retained and prefers to handle the claim directly. Explained the bodily injury claim process, including the need for medical records and itemized treatment bills. Claimant reports headaches and limited range of motion when turning the head. Advised claimant to keep all receipts and a symptom diary.

Entry 3: Police report obtained. Officer noted the other driver admitted to looking at a phone before impact. Both vehicles drivable from scene, but insured vehicle has rear bumper and trunk damage. Repair estimate requested from preferred shop. Claimant's own vehicle inspected by appraiser; damage consistent with reported impact speed.

Entry 4: Claimant visited urgent care for evaluation and was diagnosed with whiplash-associated neck strain. Received treatment plan including physical therapy referral and anti-inflammatory medication. Requested copies of urgent care records and signed medical authorization. Claimant states physical therapy has been scheduled and symptoms are slightly improved but persistent.

Entry 5: Received completed medical authorization and urgent care records from claimant. Records reviewed and consistent with reported injury and mechanism of loss. Reserves reviewed and adjusted to reflect ongoing treatment. Scheduled follow-up call in two weeks to check on physical therapy progress and request updated billing. Claim remains open pending final medical documentation.
